findings.evidence: Lines 163–171 state `ρ[fun y => ... (y r) | invariants]`, and the proof only invokes `tendsto_integral_abs_birkhoffAverage_sub_condExp`.

findings.issue: The `setIntegral_weight_mul_prefix_mul_indicator_eq_condExp` docstring calls its target the invariant conditional law `ν(B)`, although the theorem only targets a conditional expectation and deliberately has no standard-Borel assumptions needed to define that law.

summary: Several docstrings misidentify conditional-expectation results as statements about the first coordinate or the invariant conditional law.
